exposure: identifying as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander
outcome: neonatal early-onset group B streptococcus (EOGBS) infection
cohort: The study participants were neonates in tertiary hospitals in South Australia and the Northern Territory, Australia, including 139 confirmed cases of GBS infection.
finding: Maternal GBS carriage, previous fetal death, Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander identity, and maternal fever in labor/chorioamnionitis were identified as risk factors for EOGBS, with GBS remaining a leading cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality.
